viewing_check: Estimate 40-80, current bid $30 (+22% premium = about $37). No tea or coffee set sale found on Terapeak (AU, US and GB, 3 years, 5 wordings): only vases, sculptures and small pieces by Warlamis, A$89-435, with the black/white striped cake stand A$291 (Jan 2026). Dealer asking prices for single coffee pots are USD 300 / EUR 817 and a 9-piece service was estimated EUR 600-700 at Dorotheum in 2015, so a full set may be worth many times the current bid but there is no firm sold price for a set. Andy should check for a Vienna Collection / Heide Warlamis backstamp under the pot and cups (none visible in photos), count the pieces (photos show pot, jug, sugar bowl, 6 cups, 6 saucers), and inspect for chips to the fine angled handles, which are fragile. Prices for Warlamis look firm to rising 2024-2026. If unmarked, it may be a copy or similar Memphis-style set worth far less.
